title: Symbol usage
slide_intent: Teach designers when a short symbol can identify a brand in limited space. Its role changes with the viewer’s familiarity and the space available.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can carry its identity onto a badge, profile avatar or browser tab where the full name could become too small to distinguish.
demonstration: An application montage repeats the person across a shirt, cards, badges, a browser tab, posters and social posts.
practical_value: Choose the person for a small or informal placement where the audience can recognize the shorthand; inspect it at the final size.

content_islands.name: Shorthand guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the symbol usage heading and explanation in the left text column. Relate size and existing recognition to the choice of mark.

content_islands.name: Physical applications
content_islands.spec: Layer the pink shirt, green card and colored badges across the main field. Preserve identifiable object edges so scale remains apparent.

content_islands.name: Screen applications
content_islands.spec: Overlap a browser tab, social posts and profile view at right. Keep the differently sized person marks visible together.
